issue.title: pipes in Angular 2

milestone.title: alpha-31
milestone.description: Closing milestone.  Work on all issues to complete by Monday July 14 @ 8am PT; sync internal/external by July 15 EOD.

issue.body:
Now that we have a way to "register" our own pipes (overwrite the existing registry) which features/DSL in Angular 1 should be transferred over? One feature is passing arguments for something like the famous `filterFilter` and any other `filter` that can take arguments. for example let's just assume we have a `FilterPipe` ``` html
  • {{ items | json }}
    • ``` In Angular 1 we use colon to signal that it's an argument. We also add event more colons for more arguments. ``` html
  • {{ items | json }}
    • ``` What if we used parentheses rather than colons. If we used parentheses this time around the intent is a bit more clear. I can already use the feature of using parentheses for arguments [app/components/app.ts#L162](https://github.com/angular-class/angular2-reactive-starter/blob/2f29104a32df4bbbaff82fd28b65316cd92907f8/src/app/components/app.ts#L162) using [GetPipe](https://github.com/angular-class/angular2-reactive-starter/blob/2f29104a32df4bbbaff82fd28b65316cd92907f8/src/common/rxPipes.ts#L38) but it doesn't allow for when you don't want arguments. (keep in mind I made that pipe because I didn't have elvis operator in alpha.25) ``` html
  • {{ items | json }}
    • ``` ``` html
  • {{ items | json }}
    • ```

    CollectionLocal

    What about including a `$collection` local that would allow you to place the collection in any argument ``` html
  • {{ items | json }}
    • ```

    AdHocFunctions

    What about ad hoc functions as pipes? In Angular 1 we only needed a function on the scope in order for our function to filter any data we wanted. At the moment we are missing that feature in Angular 2. Having this feature was great for prototyping a filter or we can add a decorator that will turn it into a Pipe to be used ``` html ```

    FunctionBind

    Also what about [Function Bind Syntax (bind operator)](https://github.com/zenparsing/es-function-bind) that's in ES7 strawman phase at the moment. With syntax like function-bind (which is also in Dart) then you may not need to use pipes for filters with something like [the examples](https://github.com/zenparsing/es-function-bind#examples) ``` es6 import { map, takeWhile, forEach } from "some-developer-iterator-library"; getPlayers() ::map(x => x.character()) ::takeWhile(x => x.strength > 100) ::forEach(x => console.log(x)); ``` or something like [ng-lodash](https://github.com/rockabox/ng-lodash) in angular one where you allow the developer to provide their own iterator compatible library (just as `@memo` or `@debounce` decorators) rather then having it baked into the framework. another example (https://twitter.com/BenLesh/status/602923031934021633) ``` es6 function customOp() { return this.map(x => 'custom ' + x); } myObservable::customOp().subscribe(success); ```

    Comprehension

    [ES7 Array/Generator Comprehension](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Operators/Array_comprehensions) There is also the question of es6 Array Comprehension in the template syntax but that's probably another directive ``` es6 // syntax [for (x of iterable) x] [for (x of iterable) if (condition) x] [for (x of iterable) for (y of iterable) x + y] /* ... */ [for (i of [ 1, 2, 3 ]) i*i ]; ``` sidenote issue: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/1680 ~~when I use a pipe inside a function invocation I have to wrap it in parentheses for the expression to work in the correct order `Rating {{ rate((model.getValue('rating') | async)) }}` initially that's fine since it forces the user to be explicit about their expressions but it doesn't look that great. If we allowed functions to be used as ad hoc pipes then we could simply do `Rating {{ model.getValue('rating') | async | rate }}` unwrapping with async before transforming it~~ update: added Function::bind and Array Comprehension, and GetPipe [![github-tipe-logo](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1016365/34912701-7edec34c-f89c-11e7-8c89-bed6cef064b5.png)](https://tipe.io?ref=github-comment)
